sinopsis.es: Una experiencia autobiográfica aborda la identidad negra y disidente de género, la discriminación y la búsqueda de reconocimiento.
sinopsis.en: Autobiographical story of a black and gender dissident person that shows how his feelings have been throughout his childhood and adolescence, aimed at recognizing his conflicts as a result of discrimination, but how he was able to deal with those situations to build a more friendly identity for himself. same.
